dmp.description:
The WELDIFY project addresses the growing need to develop a skilled workforce in welding circular and reused metals. As the construction and automotive sectors increasingly rely on recycled metallic infrastructures, high-tech welding technologies are essential to mitigate the catastrophic consequences of poor-quality welding, which can lead to infrastructure failure and, in severe cases, loss of life due to component breakage.The project highlights the critical role of circular economy practices, automation, safety, inclusivity, and sustainability in tackling industry challenges. Its primary goal is to develop and promote training materials that emphasize the use of recycled materials, safety protocols, and environmentally friendly practices in welding and material joining.

The main objective of the Data Management Plan of the WELDIFY project is to outline the ways in which data are collected, generated, and/or processed throughout the lifespan of a research project.
